description: Team from Mérida, Yucatán, on the Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots challenge. K’áak’ means “fire” in Yucatec Maya. Every spring our peninsula burns: satellites detect tens of thousands of hotspots a year, but two sensor generations can’t be compared directly. We’re building one consistent fire calendar from 25 years of satellite records. Skills: data analysis, anomaly detection, dashboards, cybersecurity.
